en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a rustic wooden log‑cabin interior. The room contains a simple table with a chair by a multi‑pane window, a wooden bed or daybed along the log wall, another plain chair, and an ornate cast‑iron stove on the right. Two small framed pictures hang on the walls. Along the bottom edge is printed descriptive text and a photographer's signature.
